title.narrative: Op2 Multi Stakeholder Partnerships supported

description.narrative: This indicator counts the number of Multi Stakeholder Partnerships (MSP) set up and/or supported by the FISH4ACP project. In some cases, the MSP is established by the project, in others, the MSP is based on already existing bodies which receive project support. A Multi Stakeholder Partnership is a platform composed of sector stakeholders representing all functions of the value chain with a common interest in developing the value chain. Depending on the country and sector, the MSP may involve a large number of stakeholders, and because of this there is a need to establish a smaller group of willing actors, or value chain champions, who are willing to assist the implementation process in a consistent, committed and handson way. Support can be through the organization of meetings, providing travel support for members, secretarial support to the MSP, facilitation and guidance.

title.narrative: IO3 Governments and value chain actors are adopting and implementing management measures, strategies, plans for seafood value chains supported by FISH4ACP

description.narrative: This result captures the number of agreed, adopted / authorised and implemented management measures, regulations, legislations, plans or strategies that have been developed or reviewed as part of the VC Upgrading Strategies. The scope is relatively wide as the result captures a range of different type of drafted policy documents, regulations, management measures, plans, protocols and strategies at VC level or at a certain geographic level. This stretches from community action plans to national marketing strategies to proposals for new regulations and legal texts at policy level.

title.narrative: IO10 Constraints in inputs limiting aquaculture development are being improved

description.narrative: This result captures the number of constraints that have been improved / reduced in aquaculture. The scope ranges from constraints such as inaccessibility of finance or inputs, unavailability of affordable feed or seed items; poor quality of fingerlings; unavailability or insufficiency of cold storage and poor business relationships within the value chain.

title.narrative: IO4 Governments and competent authorities are improving in different areas of implementation and enforcement of management measures

description.narrative: This result captures the number of improvements that can be observed in the 12 Value Chains. The scope ranges from an increased capability, frequency or intensity of operations concerning the enforcement of rules, the improved of monitoring the compliance with certain standards, rules and regulations. These improvements must concern the actions of VC actors, their products and/or their processes. The main interest of this result is to register positive change that has occurred based on the activities that facilitated an improved implementation and / or enforcement of rules and regulations and industry standards at the VC levels.

title.narrative: IO5 Value chain actors are increasingly complying with management measures

description.narrative: This result captures the number of improvements that can be observed in the behaviour and practices of Value Chain actors in complying with VC rules, regulations and standards. The main interest of the result is to register positive change in VC actors in complying with VC rules, regulations and industry standards. The scope of improvements in compliance ranges from vessels improving their hygiene standards, vessels officially registered, operating with licence, reduction of incidences of illegal seizures reported, more SSFF complying with environmental regulations, more farmers complying with rules and regulations etc.

title.narrative: IO6 New businesses/cooperatives and clusters are created

description.narrative: This result captures the number of new businesses created as a direct effect of the project intervention. This includes the creation of new businesses, cooperatives, GIEs (economic interest groups), organisations, and networks.The scope ranges from setting up new/consolidated farms/nurseries/production units/ laboratories/hatcheries or any other business of direct relevance to the value chain that have been established by VC actors or NonVC actors. In addition, the number of organisations, such as fish / fish worker organisations, industry boards, VCspecific fora and networks that have been newly set up and are actively operating are also captured.

title.narrative: IO9 New quality labels and products are established and available on the market

description.narrative: This result captures the number of newly developed products, byproducts, or subproducts that have been manufactured and are on the market. This also includes any environmental, health and safety, or quality labels that have been developed and are now established on the market. The scope ranges from existing products that have been significantly transformed to new products or byproducts that have been created and are on the market for sale. The establishing of new labels providing environmental or quality assurance for the customer are also included in this indicator.
